rationale: The original short thesis relied on price remaining suppressed below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($63.73) and pressing lower highs toward the session low, along with a weak broader market. Instead, price immediately reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA, snapped the lower-highs sequence by pushing to $63.98, and coincides with a broader market bounce (SPY improving from -2.16% to -2.04%, VIXY dropping from +12.99% to +12.12%). With the intraday breakdown premise negated and price just 7 cents from hard invalidation in the final 22 minutes of the session, exiting immediately preserves capital.
